title: List down top 3 German drivers who has the shortest average pit stop durati
question:
List down top 3 German drivers who has the shortest average pit stop duration and were born between 1980-1985.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; born between 1980-1985 refers to 1980< year(dob)>1985; Average pitstop duration refers to Divide(SUM(duration),COUNT(duration)); shortest average refers to Min(avg(duration));

prediction.sql: SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039 FROM drivers AS "d" JOIN pitStops AS "p" ON "p".XCL_050 = "d".XCL_034 WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German' AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) > 1980 AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) < 1985 GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039 ORDER BY AVG(CAST(p.XCL_054 AS REAL)) ASC LIMIT 3

arguments.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM drivers d
JOIN pitStops p ON p.XCL_050 = d.XCL_034
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) > 1980
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) < 1985
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
ORDER BY AVG(CAST(p.XCL_054 AS REAL)) ASC
LIMIT 3;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, AVG(p.XCL_054) AS avg_dur
FROM pitStops p
JOIN drivers d ON p.XCL_050 = d.XCL_034
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND 1980 <= CAST(strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.XCL_040) AS INTEGER) <= 1985
GROUP BY d.XCL_034
ORDER BY avg_dur ASC
LIMIT 3;
